interactions.text: ACME Corp is interested in our enterprise analytics platform because they need better visibility into sales performance and reporting.
The customer said our pricing is too high and asked whether we can offer a discount.
ACME Corp is also evaluating Salesforce as an alternative solution.
The CTO will be the final technical decision maker. The CTO is particularly concerned about integration effort and implementation risk.
ACME Corp requested a revised proposal with flexible pricing before the next meeting.
ACME Corp asked for a live product demo with their sales operations team next week.

IMPORTANT VERIFIED FACT: ACME Corp requested a live product demo for next week. ACME Corp did NOT provide an exact calendar date or date range. The exact demo date is unknown until the customer provides it.
